assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. GLAZE QUIVER RIFFLES. Asset TYPE: FLAT 2D LABORATORY QUIVER-MAP ART of a tangible NATURE silhouette. Build the ENTIRE subject using ONLY60to100 LARGE SEPARATED vector-arrow glyphs. Each glyph has a short straight shaft and a clear broad V arrowhead,crisp uniform opaque flat colour. The positions/headings of these arrows define the complete recognizable silhouette;locally aligned directions curve around its organic anatomy. The ONLY nontransparent pixels in the entire artwork are the ARROW GLYPHS themselves. Every gap between every pair of arrows is alphaZERO. Nothing underneath or around them: no body fill,pastel underlay,shading,translucent skin,glow,halo,outline,floor or shadow. This is a planar vector-analysis plot,never arrows printed on a3D object. Use direction-coded muted cobalt blue,kelp green and warm coral,with a few pale-peach arrows. Large glyphs,clear spacing,roughly8to12 arrows along the longest dimension. No tiny hundreds-of-arrows texture,no dots,particles,long trails,curly streamlines,physical material,mosaic grains,projection stripes or solid nature illustration. Fictional artistic optical-flow map,not measured data. No axes,legend,scale bars,text,letters,numerals,clock/dates/readings,logos or watermark. Subject: FAN-ROOT MANGROVE: one short natural sapling with THREE broad arching PROP ROOTS descending from a bent single trunk and a low canopy of FIVE unequal thick oval paddle leaves. Two leaves overlap and one rolls slightly inward,leaving generous gaps between root arches and leaf lobes. Entire tree/silhouette made from short vector-arrow fields,all roots thick enough to contain several arrow rows. Three-quarter side view,no fine twig clutter,no pot,house or architectural gate. Asset: ONE square1024x1024 pure-art widget. All complete parts inside central72%canvas,empty margins. True transparent alpha outside and BETWEEN ALL ARROWS and through body gaps. No rectangular field,extra subjects,UI,frame,contact sheet or mockup.
